text: “Not much of that to be got in Bensersiel,” I laughed. “I’m afraid you’ll have a dull afternoon. Look here. I know you can’t leave your boat altogether, and it’s no use asking Herr Davies; but will you drive into Esens with me and see a Frisian town—for what it’s worth? You’re getting a dismal impression of Friesland.” I excused myself, said I would stop with Davies; we would walk out over the sands and prospect for the evening’s sail.
